question: What are bases that are soluble in water called?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Alkalis**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Alkalis** are bases that are soluble in water.
 
• Common examples of alkalis include sodium hydroxide (NaOH) and potassium hydroxide (KOH).
